methods.primary_window: post_ramp_walk: [7 s, requested run end), all available walking after the velocity command ramp. Observations last 17/21/38/17 s; duration differs by original run.
methods.primary_window_reason: Retain terrain transitions and later obstacles instead of selecting a local window around a favourable event. The four original runs are descriptive scenario observations, not a strict terrain-difficulty ranking.
methods.transition_window: [base-entry - 5 s, base-entry + 5 s), supplementary common-duration transition analysis; no contact-time claim.
methods.tilt_combined_rms_deg: sqrt(mean(roll_deg^2 + pitch_deg^2)); actual base orientation relative to world horizontal, including mean lean.
methods.max_abs_tilt_axis_deg: max over samples of max(abs(roll_deg), abs(pitch_deg)).
methods.velocity: vx_body = cos(yaw)*vx_world + sin(yaw)*vy_world; RMSE relative to logged cmd_vx_body_m_s. Horizontal heading frame, not full 3D body-frame rotation.
methods.knee_angles: PhysX actual joint positions from q_rad:J_knee_l_pitch and q_rad:J_knee_r_pitch, converted to degrees. Range/correlation describe actual joint movement, not foot clearance or contact.
methods.controller_support_switch: controller:leg_state: 0 left support, 1 right support, 2 double support. Switching uses estimated force and phase. This is controller scheduling, not measured foot contact, measured stance time, or actual step length. CV = 100 * population standard deviation / mean of intervals between consecutive switches wholly observed within the window.
methods.sampling: Metrics use 100-Hz states.csv; support-switch timings have one sample (0.01 s) resolution. Raw physics peaks can exceed sampled peaks.
methods.run_end: status completed, physics step count and elapsed simulation duration must match requested duration, with no failure.json. This distinguishes duration end from a recorded instability stop.
methods.comparison_scope: Four scenario-specific configurations differ in speed and step height. Descriptive gait/stability diagnosis only; not a controlled causal ranking of terrain difficulty. No repeated-trial reliability estimate.
methods.geometric_scope: No region-traversal pass/fail criterion. Base-entry time merely aligns the curves. Sparse obstacles are not verified foot-by-foot because these original logs lack contact prim identifiers and measured foot-contact flags.

entry_alignment.definition: First logged base origin x >= terrain start while y lies in the terrain bounds; a geometric alignment proxy, not first foot contact.

run_end.scope: Finite observed run only; duration completion alone is not a stability proof.

terrain_inside.definition: Samples whose base origin lies inside the terrain x/y bounds; not measured foot contact.
